updates.note: Management stated aim to reach 10% export turnover in next five years.
updates.quote: we want to finally aim at 10% of our revenues through export. So, we are working systematically to see that we reach that goal in next five years.

updates.note: Reiterated R&D investment of more than INR 2,200 crores for the year.
updates.quote: more than INR2,200 crores R&D budget we have allocated for this year

updates.note: Reiterated 15% revenue growth guidance for FY27.
updates.quote: The revenue growth of 15%... guidance definitely we are working towards and I am confident we will achieve this guidance for this financial year.

updates.note: Guidance previously 28% EBITDA margin, but closing remark mentioned 21% to 23% for quarterly range while maintaining 28% annual.
updates.quote: EBITDA margin 21% to 23%... overall on a yearly basis, we maintain the EBITDA margin of 28%

updates.note: Reiterated order inflow guidance of INR 55,000+ crores for the year.
updates.quote: guidance given about the order inflow for this year... INR55,000 plus crores, including QRSAM.

updates.note: Reiterated R&D budget of more than INR 2,200 crores.
updates.quote: more than INR2,200 crores R&D budget we have allocated for this year

updates.note: Reiterated capex guidance of more than INR 1,200 crores.
updates.quote: INR1,200 plus crores we are investing under capex

new_promises.statement: We target USD 300 million in export orders for this financial year.
new_promises.quote: this year we have given our internal guidance of around USD300 million we should definitely fetch out of the leads which we are having.
new_promises.speaker: Manoj Jain
